meta.name: Funny Farm
meta.description: Sportswriter Andy Farmer moves with his schoolteacher wife Elizabeth to the country in order to write a novel in relative seclusion. Of course, seclusion is the last thing the Farmers find in the small, eccentric town, where disaster awaits them at every turn.
meta.slogan: Chevy Chase finds life in the country isn't what it's cracked up to be!
